notes: Second provider of the `decide` inference type: Convai Innovations' open-weights Laya, reached at a configured base URL (a Laya server or a LiteLLM pass-through route); it has no built-in endpoint, so LAYA_BASE_URL or credentials.laya.baseURL is required. Tier 3 for the same reasons as typesafe (the catalog schema has no decide vocabulary and requires output-token fields). Extends SystemOneDecisionProvider, which it shares with typesafe. Declares inferenceKinds ["decide"] and decisionLimits, and sits after typesafe in HAND_DESCRIPTORS so typesafe stays the default whenever a TypeSafe key (TYPESAFE_API_KEY or AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY) is set.
